This page has a table with relative column widths, which is its only Pandoc table, and a table that knitr writes as raw LaTeX. @tbl-rel wraps, and @tbl-raw keeps its normal layout.

| Item       | Count | Note                                            |
|----------------------------|--------------|----------------------------------------------------------|
| alpha      | 3     | The note column holds the most text.            |
| beta       | 12    | Its dashes give it the largest share.           |

: A table with relative widths {#tbl-rel .wrap-right width="45%"}
